    Make a line plot showing the average score across different regions

    makeLinePlot.Rd

    Make a line plot showing the average score across different regions

    makeLinePlot(
  obj,
  gr = NULL,
  window.size = 5,
  group = NULL,
  group.colors = NULL,
  group.label = "",
  plot.average.of.groups = FALSE,
  avg.color = "red",
  show.x.ticks = FALSE,
  ylab = "",
  remove.chr.prefix = TRUE,
  verbose = F
)

    Arguments

    obj

    SCCNVis object

    gr

    A GenomicRanges::GRanges object specifying which regions to plot. If NULL, all regions will be plotted. Default = NULL

    window.size

    Window size for moving average calculation

    group

    Name of metadata column to group lines by. Default = NULL

    group.colors

    Named character vector. Names should be the values in the column specified by 'group', values are the colors. Default = NULL

    plot.average.of.groups

    Logical. If TRUE, plot each cluster individually and an additional line representing the average of each cluster. Default = FALSE

    avg.color

    Color. Used for the color of the cluster average, if plot.average.of.clusters == T. Default = 'red'

    show.x.ticks

    Logical. If TRUE, show tick marks on X axis. Only recommended when showing smaller regions. Default = FALSE

    ylab

    Character. Label of y axis. Default = ""

    remove.chr.prefix

    Remove 'chr' prefix of chromosome names. Default = TRUE

    verbose

    Verbose logging. Default = FALSE

    Value

    Returns a list containing "Plot" (ggplot) and "PlotData" (data.frame)
